notes.title: Third Demo patch
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube="T31dyT3hnyo;full"][/previewyoutube]


Hoping your weekend is great, as always! 

Work on the level design and quests for the first area are progressing well, everything is noice.

Hopefully tomorrow or on Monday I'll be able to provide a little WIP peek at what there is already. It's a lot of fun to be hiding little things in nooks and crannies for you to find. 



Until then, the question of more outlandish Prostethics came up frequently - So here's footage of a more Melee oriented one. 



It allows you instant unsheathing, and you can't drop your weapon + it can't be looted off of you, aside from looking badass. 



And also, I've had the chance to work on addressing some weak points in the combat system, which I'm releasing now in a new patch for the Demo! I still have lots of things to improve on my todo list, but it can be done nicely while the work is happening for Alpha 1. 



Thank you guys for all the awesome feedback this week as well!

notes.title: First Demo Patch
notes.notes:
Hey hey everyone!  

Thank you very much for the awesome reception Sword Hero has received in the past few days. It's been incredible to see and read how everyone felt about the Demo. 

Now comes the part - What's next for Sword Hero? 

First of all - 0.0.11 patch for the Demo is up now - And over the weekend, I will be preparing a Roadmap and updating the website, where I will have an entire section dedicated to the lore of Sword Hero for people who are interested - and some sneak peeks at locations that will be in the full game.   

In the meantime, please enjoy this awesome illustration @агата (Discord) helped me a while back, depicting the first little village of Ironshire, based on my doodles.   

And as previously as well, if you'll meet a crash, please send me your player.log files in DM on Discord, so I can use them to help me track down the source of the issue.   

Today went away mostly to create 0.0.11, so let me put here the changelog: 


Fixed Psi getting awarded even attacks miss or get blocked

Fixed Radial menus getting stuck if player dies while they're open

Added support for 5120x1440 resolution

Fixed glowing barrel-water

Fixed missing Limb message getting sent multiple times per frame

Fixed particles being spawned while game is Paused

Fixed disappearing NPC issue and related Crash when ending Pause (DisappearingDarius)

Fixed premature inner arena gate closing

Arena now checks for any creature inside the Hallway before closing it

Added Death message

Added Demo end message

Removed duplicate lightsource from shop area

Tabbed Settings menu

Added option for Classic Camera mode

Added option to switch off Camera Correction

Added options to invert Look directions

Added option to have Attack Dir be based on Look direction

Added option to select when to have Kill Slow motions

Esc now correctly closes Settings/Controls menu

Fixed "Controls" text

Loot window now closes if lootable container is closed

Disabled jumping while using an interactable

Slightly increased interaction radius

Fixed some sounds not being tied to volume settings

Disabled using abilities while crawling

Creatures' Inventory will correctly contain their sheathed weapons

Added tooltip warning to trading if your offer is worth more than what you're asking for.

Creatures will no longer linger when being shot from afar

Fixed Item Dupe bug

Fixed a Crash related to spawning many blood droplets in a single frame

notes.title: Hey Everyone - A short update video! (Especially if you're from Reddit. :) )
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone! Thank you for checking out the Steam page.

After almost 2 years of development, I'm finally seeing the end of my Alpha TODO list. Since the flashy stuff usually comes later in a game's development cycle, it is only natural that for Sword Hero too, for the time being I'm just sharing in-progress early footages - After all, all mighty forts need a stable foundation!

Even though I'm only working on Sword Hero in my free time, I've put a lot of care into creating this foundation. This means that all the hundreds of NPCs and monsters that are going to be roaming the island with their Daily Routines, need to happen in a performant way. My goal is to allow people with somewhat entry level PCs too to enjoy Sword Hero, but optimizations will of course continue even after the alpha Demo later this year.

And now, in case you aren't familliar with my Twitter (Where I'm the most active - I'm sharing all my latest videos there, on Reddit things are a bit behind.) - Allow me to show you a little compilation of my latest Twitter posts, where I'm detailing the foundations of the Crime and NPC reactions systems.

As always, feel free to comment either here, or DM me on Twitter or just join the Discord and say hi!
